source_text: Fasciis eum involuit, qui amictus est lumine sicut vestimento. Involuit pannis eum, qui omnem formavit creaturam. Reclinavit in praesepio eum, qui super cherubim sedet, et ab infinitis Angelis collaudatur. In irrationalium animalium praesepio divinum requievit Verbum, ut hominibus vere irrationalibus secundum liberam voluntatem, rationalem sensum tribueret. In mensa iumentorum, caelestis panis propositus est: ut homines instar pecorum irrationales, mystici cibi participes redderet.
thought_title: The Creator wrapped in cloths and laid in a manger
orientation: The narrator describes Mary wrapping the newborn child and laying him in the manger of animals.
pass_a_gloss: She wrapped him in swaddling bands, him who has been clothed with light as with a garment. She wrapped in rags him who formed every created thing. She laid him down in a manger, him who sits above the cherubim and is praised together by countless angels. In the manger of unreasoning animals the divine Word rested, in order that to men who are truly unreasoning by free choice he might grant reasoning understanding. On the feeding trough of beasts the heavenly bread was set forth, in order that men who are unreasoning like cattle he might make sharers of mystic food.

lemmas.gloss: is praised together, is joined in praising

choices.why: keeps the two different Latin nouns distinct and literal
literal philosophical sense of lacking reason, applied to animals and men
keeps both elements: rational faculty and perception
mensa here is manger-trough, parallel to praesepio, not table

pass_b_english: She wrapped him in swaddling bands, him who is clothed with light as with a garment (Psalm 104:2). She wrapped in rags him who formed all creation. She laid him in a manger, him who sits upon the cherubim and is praised by countless angels (Luke 2:7). The divine Word rested in the manger of unreasoning animals, so that to human beings made truly unreasoning by their own free will he might grant reasoning understanding. In the feeding trough of beasts the heavenly bread was set forth, to make men unreasoning like cattle partakers of mystical food.
